Name: Ish-bosheth, Son of Saul
Summary: Ish-bosheth, son of Saul — also called Eshbaal — was made king over Israel by Abner after Saul's death and reigned two years from Mahanaim while David reigned at Hebron. After Abner defected, Ish-bosheth was murdered in his sleep by Rechab and Baanah, and David had the murderers executed.
KeyStory: Ish-bosheth held Saul's throne for two years, then was murdered in his own bed.
RelatedPeople: King Saul; Abner, Son of Ner; Michal; Merab
LifeLesson: A throne held by another man's strength falls when that strength walks away.
